rag_summary_count_consistency.details: The three identified-bias summary entries each report one occurrence, matching the three identified occurrence records. Candidate biases are reported separately and are not included in that identified-occurrence summary.

evaluation_limitations: This is a single interview-level evaluation; no dataset-level inference is appropriate.
The supplied segment map is authoritative, so findings are adjudicated against its four eligible reasoning segments.
The corpus-support audit cannot establish retrieval fidelity because retrieved chunks or retrieval logs were not supplied.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The sending program stood out. In my experience, students transferring from that program often needed a fairly high level of behavioral structure when they first arrived.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The coordinator generalized the assumed profile of students from the sending program to this individual before individualized records arrived, matching Group attribution error.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I was trying to get a compliant interim IEP done without creating another moving part. ... I told myself we could revisit testing at the annual review.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The coordinator chose the easier immediate path despite stale data and an acknowledged foreseeable near-term cost from delayed information, matching Present Bias.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: that report was vivid because it was the most detailed account of a difficult moment ... I worried that the same difficulty would show up in group work, independent work, and peer situations
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A single vivid negative incident generalized into an unsupported broader characterization of unrelated academic and social functioning, matching Horn Effect.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We documented why the service minutes were temporary and set a review point.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The final service-minutes and LRE decision is described as a documented whole-record judgment with no additional hidden bias instance.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Initial interim placement lean before full records arrived
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Generalizing assumed group disposition from the sending-program population onto an individual student ahead of individualized evidence.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Representativeness bias is a related but distinct construct from Group attribution error; it is not an approved alias. The predicted label is therefore a near-neighbor label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully describes using the sending-program category as a prototype for this individual before individualized records arrived and applies that inference to the initial placement decision.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The three participant quotations are valid, directly support the episode, and accurately capture the group-based inference.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Deferring reevaluation while drafting the interim IEP
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Overweighting an immediate effort or scheduling cost relative to an acknowledged, larger near-term future cost of delayed information.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Omission bias and status quo bias are adjacent explanations for retaining the current plan, but neither is an established alias for Present Bias.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The candidate correctly locates the decision and notes a foreseeable mismatch, but it does not fully specify the hidden temporal trade-off of discounting a larger near-term information cost in favor of lower immediate effort.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The supporting quote is valid and accurately reflects the participant's stated workload, timeline, and deferral rationale; the remaining issue is mechanism specificity rather than evidence fabrication.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Drafting present levels of performance after first-week reports
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: A single vivid negative behavioral data point generalizes into an unsupported, broader negative characterization of unrelated academic and social attributes.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Availability heuristic is a related but distinct salience-based construct, not an approved alias for Horn Effect.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully captures the vivid negative incident outweighing positive evidence and generalizing into broader claims about engagement and peer interactions.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted participant statements are valid and support both the salient incident and its overgeneralized effect on the PLOP narrative.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The evidence and mechanism are a full match to gae_01, but representativeness bias is not an approved equivalent of Group attribution error.

The finding describes insufficient updating after new information, whereas the exhaustive hidden manifest contains only the distinct group-generalization mechanism in this episode. It is an extra unsupported prediction, not a second match to gae_01.
The occurrence is correctly localized and fully captures the Horn Effect mechanism, but availability heuristic is a distinct label rather than an approved equivalent.
The candidate is a valid, well-localized near miss, but its omission/status-quo mechanism does not fully capture the hidden immediate-versus-near-term future cost trade-off required for Present Bias.

candidates.details: The candidate is accurately localized and identifies a plausible adjacent concern about retaining the current plan. It remains a near miss because the interview also supplies concrete deadline, caseload, and staffing constraints, and the candidate does not fully articulate the hidden Present Bias mechanism. It improves segment-level coverage at the fourth threshold but is an instance-level false positive under both scorecards.

high_only.detection_interpretation: No high-confidence finding is present; all three positive segments are missed and the sole negative segment is correctly rejected.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: The moderate-confidence availability finding detects DP3; DP1 and DP2 remain missed, with no negative-segment false alarms.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Adding low-confidence findings detects DP1 as well as DP3; DP2 remains missed and the negative segment remains correctly rejected.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Including the candidate adds a detection on DP2, yielding complete segment-level coverage without a negative-segment false alarm, although instance-level matching remains imperfect.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Full overlap with the group-to-individual generalization mechanism and initial-placement operation, but the taxonomy label is distinct.
Minimal overlap: both concern the initial-placement episode, but anchoring concerns later belief updating and is not the hidden group-generalization mechanism.
Full overlap with the vivid negative incident generalizing into an unsupported broader characterization, despite a distinct salience-oriented label.
Partial overlap with the reevaluation-deferral decision; the candidate does not fully express the immediate-effort versus acknowledged near-term future-cost trade-off.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: obs_001 claims retrieved support and supplies a paper title and passage, but source identifier, authors, and publication year are null, so the citation metadata are not independently verifiable from the supplied inputs. obs_002 and obs_003 explicitly report no specific retrieved support.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Segment hits increase 0 to 1 and mechanism-first instance true positives increase 0 to 1; strict instance performance remains at zero.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Adding low-confidence findings increases segment hits 1 to 2 and mechanism-first true positives 1 to 2, but also adds one unsupported anchoring false positive.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Adding the candidate increases segment hits 2 to 3 but adds one instance-level false positive and no strict or mechanism-first true positive.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG detects 1 of 3 positive segments with no false alarms. Including low-confidence findings detects 2 of 3; including the candidate reaches all 3 segments.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: The RAG obtains 0 strict instance true positives at every threshold because both correctly localized identified findings use near-neighbor labels; the extra anchoring finding and candidate add false positives at broader thresholds.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring credits Horn Effect at high_and_moderate and Group attribution error after low-confidence findings are included, reaching 2 true positives of 3 before candidates; the anchoring finding remains an unsupported false positive.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate improves segment-level coverage at the fourth threshold but is a well-localized instance-level near miss, so it adds no true positive and one false positive.
main_failure_modes: Near-neighbor taxonomy labels replace the hidden Group attribution error and Horn Effect labels.
The two correctly localized identified findings are assigned low confidence, limiting performance at the recommended threshold.
Anchoring bias is an unsupported extra prediction because the hidden manifest is exhaustive and contains no separate anchoring instance.
The omission-bias candidate does not fully establish the hidden Present Bias mechanism.
main_strengths: Evidence quotations are valid and accurately attributed to the participant.
The RAG correctly localizes the group-based initial-placement reasoning and vivid-incident PLOP reasoning.
Those two findings capture the hidden mechanisms despite taxonomy mismatches.
The candidate is transparently separated from identified findings and acknowledges plausible non-bias explanations.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows strong episode localization and useful mechanism sensitivity, but weak strict taxonomy alignment, conservative confidence assignment, and one unsupported additional bias claim. Results are per-run only and should be aggregated with matched benchmark runs before drawing system-level conclusions.
